title: nan
authors: Xu W.; Yang D.; Liu J.; Li Y.; Zhou M.
key_contribution: Presents a visual navigation algorithm based on visual-geography Bundle Adjustment and heterogeneous image matching for UAV real-time geographic pose estimation in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
